project.name: The Waldorf Path
project.description: A curated SaaS directory and resource platform for Waldorf / Steiner education families, mentors, and practitioners worldwide. Features 4-tab Teable-inspired directory (Find a Mentor, Guided Match, My Path, Insights), 60+ local articles, 1,015 directory entries, AI-powered search, and Stripe-ready subscriptions.

resources.description: Curated external resource links, articles, and editorial content (130+ entries)

daily_rhythms.description: Seasonal verses and daily rhythm content

accounts.description: User/mentor accounts with auth roles and billing status

admin_alerts.description: Admin alerts, sponsor inquiries, claim notifications (formerly System_Admin — no plaintext creds)

sponsor_offers.description: Sponsor applications, campaign details, payments, placements

billing_records.description: Admin-only Stripe customer, subscription, and payment references

ticker_slot.label: Home Page Ticker Slot
ticker_slot.includes: Logo, brand name, short description, direct link in homepage scrolling ticker

ticker_plus_highlight.label: Ticker + Dedicated Highlight
ticker_plus_highlight.includes: Standard ticker inclusion plus featured priority ranking banner

auth_system.admin_dashboard: Separate login with admin-specific dashboard (not in PWA Profile tab); admin users stored in Admin_Alerts table (Alert_Type='Admin User')
auth_system.session_storage: localStorage key: LOGGED_IN_USER — object: { email, role, subscriptionActive, fullName }
auth_system.public_access: Anyone can browse directory/resources without login
auth_system.gated_features: Contact mentors, submit enquiries, mentor pro features require login + subscription

directory_tabs.find_a_mentor: Search + 4 dropdown filters (developmental stage, specialty, location, profile status), list/grid toggle, pagination (20/page), bookmark to My Path, 1.5x featured cards with gold frame
directory_tabs.guided_match: 4-step wizard with progress bar (25% increments): Step 1 Child/Developmental Stage (single), Step 2 Support Goals (multi), Step 3 Specialty Needs (multi), Step 4 Location/Priorities. Continue gated on selection. Results filter mentors by choices.
directory_tabs.my_path: Browser-localStorage shortlist of bookmarked mentors. Empty state with CTA to Find a Mentor. Not stored on server.
directory_tabs.insights: Admin-only. Stats cards, colour-coded bar charts (profile status, developmental stage, location coverage, resource categories/grades), data-quality gap table.

local_content.article_viewer: Iframe fallback for complex CSS articles, in-app rendering for simpler HTML
local_content.content_registry: src/data/contentRegistry.ts — indexes all local articles/pdfs/directories with metadata (title, category, grade, tags, language)

build_optimization.code_splitting: React.lazy on EnhancedDirectory, ProfilePanel, ResourcesPanel; manualChunks splits vendor (motion/react) and icons (lucide-react)

vercel_env_vars_required.STRIPE_USER_PREMIUM_PRICE_ID: Needs Stripe price ID for user-premium plan
vercel_env_vars_required.STRIPE_MENTOR_PRO_PRICE_ID: Needs Stripe price ID for mentor-pro plan

git.deploy_trigger: Push to main auto-deploys via Vercel GitHub integration
